name: own-proposal-worse

finding.title: A request without `limit` now returns no items
finding.description: The new line drops the `?? 20` default. When a client omits `limit`, `Number(undefined)` is `NaN` and `Math.min(NaN, 100)` is `NaN`, so `findMany({ take: NaN })` returns no items. Before this change a request without `limit` returned the first 20 items.

priorRound.title: Unbounded `limit` lets a client fetch every row
